Alexa (PM): Heads-up — final draft of the one-pager for enterprise security/SLA/deploy modes is in Google Drive. Need quick sync on messaging and routing before EOD.
Ben (Field): Link? I wanna skim for customer-facing language.
Alexa (PM): https://drive.redwood/onepagers/enterprise-ops-ppg (edited) — focus is: 'Secure, predictable inference across hosted, dedicated, and private.' Keep it short.
Carla (Sales): Quick ask: include a 1-line rebuttal for "we already run on cloud infra" — buyers need why Redwood is different vs DIY.
Erin (PMM): Proposed line: "Stop trading time and SLAs for scale — Redwood gives predictable latency and enterprise controls without building your own serving stack." Thoughts?
Dave (Solutions Eng): I like it. Add a one-liner on low-effort migrations: "drop-in API, can pin model versions and route to private pools" — that helps sales objections.
Farah (Design): I pushed a tighter visual: 3-panel layout (Security | SLAs | Deploy Modes) + micro-benchmark callout. Uploaded as v2 in the doc.
Gavin (Deployments): For the benchmark snippet, please don't promise numeric p99 without region/instance context. Suggest: "benchmarks: median token latency reduced by up to 40% vs standard endpoints in controlled tests" with a footnote link to the full benchmark repo.
doc-bot: Document updated by Farah at 2026-03-21T14:02:31Z
Ben (Field): Good — also add an inbound routing note: "leads requesting private deployments -> tag as 'private_deploy_interest' and route to AE+SecSE". That helped close two deals last quarter.
Carla (Sales): Can we get a sample email snippet and a 2-sentence pitch to paste into outreach? Helps SDRs move quickly.
Erin (PMM): I'll draft 2 versions: Technical (for platform buyers) and Executive (for security/compliance buyers). Will drop them in the doc in 15.
Alexa (PM): Nice. For the webinar/benchmark narrative — we need a 30–45s opener: problem statement + what Redwood delivers + call-to-action (benchmarks + trial). Erin, can you own the script?
Erin (PMM): Yep. Outline: 1) Market problem (unreliable SLAs/cost surprises), 2) Our approach (unified serving + routing + caching), 3) Results (micro-benchmarks + customer vignette), 4) CTA (book a demo/request private trial).
Dave (Solutions Eng): I can provide the benchmark graph and the short demo steps. Will record a 4-min tech walkthrough for the on-demand asset.
Farah (Design): Will make a webinar slide pack and 1-pager handout. Need final text by 4pm to get assets in place for next week's field send.
Alexa (PM): Timeline check — final copy by 4pm, design by 6pm, Erin records script by EOD. Ben/Carla, any other requests?
Ben (Field): Add a one-row grid mapping "customer need -> recommended deployment mode". Field likes decision aids.
Carla (Sales): Include pricing guidance bullets (high-level: hosted pay-as-you-go, reserved for dedicated, licensing for private). No numbers, just guidance.
Gavin (Deployments): I'll add a short checklist for customer readiness (network, KMS, compliance docs) that Sales can share during discovery.
Alexa (PM): Great. If everyone sticks to the timeline we can lock the one-pager and publish the launch post + webinar invite w/ benchmark preview by Thu AM.
Erin (PMM): Uploading Exec/Tech email snippets now.
Dave (Solutions Eng): Uploaded benchmark PNG + demo notes into the doc.
Farah (Design): Uploaded final one-pager mock and slide deck v1. Looks cleaner.
Carla (Sales): Thanks — I'll prep an SDR playbook routing sheet.
Alexa (PM): Perfect. Last thing: please add the doc tags: `launch`, `enterprise`, `security`, `sla`, `private-deploy`, `field-handoff`. I will route the final to product for sign-off.
Ben (Field): :thumbsup:
Carla (Sales): :rocket:
Alexa (PM): Closing this thread after sign-off — will ping when published.
